answer: Every new agent locks a 500 POA bond for three epochs before it can earn, and peers check that the bond was not lent back by the same funder. A shop bot selling saffron, one renting dune buggies and one quoting marble tiles each need their own bond, so 100 fakes tie up 50,000 POA and sit idle three epochs; splitting money across many wallets fails because every wallet still posts the full bond. An honest agent pays once and gets it refunded on exit.
